scales._note: Our own A to E scales, like a nutrition label. Every cut-off is here so anyone can argue with it. Lower is better on every scale except jobs_per_mapped_site and straight_talk.

pue.why: E starts at the industry average (1.54). A is about the best the big cloud companies report.

wue.why: E starts at the industry average Amazon's page implies (0.84).

tax_usd_per_home.why: Our own scale. State sales tax not collected, shared across every Texas home.

jobs_per_mapped_site.unit: jobs per data center on the map, higher is better
jobs_per_mapped_site.why: Our own scale. The good side of the ledger: it pulls the overall letter up.

straight_talk.why: Holds up = 1, holds on paper only = 0.5, can't be checked = 0.25, does not hold up = 0. Averaged.

operator_metrics.quote: In 2025, the average annual power usage effectiveness for our global fleet of data centers was 1.09.
our data centers reported an average global PUE of 1.14
global data center WUE of 0.12 liters of water withdrawn per kilowatt-hour of IT Load

operator_metrics.note: Uptime Institute 2025 survey, as cited by Google
operator_metrics.quote: the global average PUE of respondents' data centers was 1.54

operator_metrics.note: Implied: Amazon says its 0.12 L/kWh is more than 7 times better than the industry average
operator_metrics.quote: 7 times better than the industry average

tax.source: Texas Comptroller, Tax Exemptions and Tax Incidence, January 2025, page 5, Tax Code 151.359 (includes 151.3595)
tax.rules: To qualify, a data center must invest at least $200 million and create at least 20 jobs. A large project must invest at least $500 million and create at least 40 jobs.
